---
title: "Bediya Royi Kabhi"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

bediya royeyn kabhi paon ke chale roye

kaise qaidi thay jinhe qaid ke taale roye

jab suna maara gaya pani pilane wala

kaampte haton may sukhe hue pyale roye

bediya royeyn…

jane kya sochke shabbir bahot dayr talak

karke baysheer ko turbat ke hawale roye

bediya royeyn….

bhoolne walay tujhe kaise bataye koi

kis khadar tujhko tere chahne walay roye

bediya royeyn….

bekasi baap ko le aayi hai kis manzil par

barchi bete ke kaleje se nikale roye

bediya royeyn…

haye afsos ke jis waqt jale thay qaime

dayr tak shame ghariban ko ujale roye

bediya royeyn…

pyase jismo may ye paywast hue jab bhi kabhi

dekh kar sookhi ragay barchiya bhaalay roye

bediya royeyn…

bhai ki laash hai aur shor yateemo ka nazeer

ek behan aise may bachon sambhale roye

bediya royeyn…

_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(text):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in text.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert list(map(len, r)) == list(map(len, u)) == [5] + [4]*6
for n in range(1, 7):
    assert r[n][0].strip() == str(n) and u[n][0] == '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶'[n]
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 23 matching lyric lines across the opening and six numbered stanzas.')

item.text:
Reconstructed **بیڑیاں روئیں کبھی** in Urdu script and preserved the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Verified that all 23 lyric lines align across the opening and six numbered stanzas, including the recurring refrain. Updated the Urdu title and text direction, retained the Roman title, and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

I rendered the ambiguous `baysheer` as `بے شیر` and the closing takhallus `Nazeer` as `نظیر`.
